name: hermit-778de329-blind30-ots
instr:
# Hermit: thirty behavioural regressions in a package manager, to be diagnosed without a test suite

This tool pins versions of developer tools into a per-project workspace and puts them in front of whoever enters it. It builds as it always did, but an alarming number of everyday operations now come back wrong. The repository has received 30 separate undocumented edits. Nothing about the packages, the remote servers or the people driving it is different, and the damage is spread widely, so please keep going after the first few are understood.

Bringing a package in is the most visible casualty. A package whose definition asks for an outside program to be executed once its contents are unpacked does not work: the install either reports a failure or finishes with that program's effect missing, so a tiny script that should have created a file leaves nothing behind. In the same way, a package that should put one of its bundled files at a chosen location on disk finishes without that location existing, and the variant that also fixes the mode of the written file behaves identically. The progress output printed while packages are being installed and taken away has gained extra empty entries between the real messages. Asking for an installed package to be taken away by name now finishes silently: neither of the two messages that normally accompany it is printed.
